author: National Geographic
description:
Join National Graphic in this Drain the Oceans MEGA episode exploring wreckages from World War II battles around the world. Featuring three full episodes:

The Battle of Britain
In summer 1940, Great Britain stood alone against the Nazis. Now we uncover the wrecks that reveal the truth behind the Battle of Britain. 

Japan's Surprise Attack
In 1942, Japan came to dominate the Pacific region. The secret as to how they did it lies waiting to be discovered. 

The Killer U-Boats
Draining the oceans reveals the story of the U-Boats as they took on the Royal Navy, sinking 12 million tons of ships and nearly winning the war.
